note: Schema derive / schema_type! fixes: serde(default = "Vec::new") / "String::new" / "Default::default" / "<T>::default" document the type default and Self::f / Type::f resolve inherent impl functions instead of a compile error; crate:: default fn paths follow pub use re-exports; garde expression arguments (length / range bounds, pattern, contains / prefix / suffix, if cond, custom arguments) re-root the source module's constants and statics; usize / isize sea_orm default_value literals are checked at the target's pointer width; a multipart DTO that cannot carry the source container default keeps its bare Vec parts optional; nested cfg_attr items are carried under all(..); inline relation type names keep non-ASCII identifier characters and escape the rest without collisions; array length constants are re-rooted; a bare source name follows top-level use imports and pub use re-exports; a multipart alias repeating the field's own name is not a collision and a bare default fn named like a field is called as written (the field's local is renamed); schema!(a::T) reads the item of module a when same-named items of several modules share one definition.
